items.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon（阿尔贡）
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Argon appears to be a new variant in Google's Gemini 4 family, signaling ongoing expansion of the model lineup to cover different price-performance tiers. Argon is pitched as a balance between capability and efficiency, giving enterprises a more cost-effective path to scale language-model workloads.
items.summary_zh: 这是谷歌在 Gemini 4 系列中的一个新变体，凸显通过分层定价来覆盖不同用例的策略。Argon 版本强调在性能与效率之间的折中，面向需要大规模语言模型但关注成本的企业场景。

items.title_en: The top secret URSALA, RAQUEL, and FARRAH satellites (2025)
items.title_zh: 绝密卫星：URSALA、RAQUEL 与 FARRAH
items.summary_en: Explores the rumored trio of top-secret satellites codenamed URSALA, RAQUEL, and FARRAH, piecing together what little public metadata can imply about their missions.
items.summary_zh: 探讨被传闻为绝密的三颗卫星，代号为 URSALA、RAQUEL 与 FARRAH，并结合公开数据尝试推断它们的任务。强调隐蔽资产对跟踪与信息解密带来的复杂性，以及现有轨道数据空白对其存在与用途的暗示。

items.title_en: You said no MCP
items.title_zh: Pi.dev：你说不要 MCP
items.summary_en: Pi.dev questions the use of MCP and outlines the rationale behind rejecting it.
items.summary_zh: Pi.dev 质疑 MCP 的使用，并解释拒绝的原因。

items.title_en: 56k.rip – the 1996 dial-up internet experience
items.title_zh: 56k.rip：1996 年的拨号上网体验
items.summary_en: 56k.rip recreates the 1996 dial-up internet experience, presenting retro webpages, slow-loading content, and nostalgic design elements as an interactive archive. It offers a tangible lens into how bandwidth constraints shaped early web aesthetics and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: 56k.rip 以互动档案的形式再现 1996 年的拨号上网体验，呈现怀旧网页、缓慢加载和早期网络美学。它让人直观感受到带宽限制如何塑造了早期网页设计与用户期望。

items.title_en: EDG C++ front-end goes public
items.title_zh: EDG C++ 前端公开发布
items.summary_en: EDG's C++ front-end has been made public, opening access to mature parsing and semantic-analysis tooling. The release could influence compiler development and language tooling, lowering barriers for research and experimentation with C++ front-end technology.
items.summary_zh: EDG 的 C++ 前端公开发布，向开发者开放了成熟的语法分析与语义分析工具链。这一举动可能改变编译器工具生态，降低研究与试验 C++ 前端技术的门槛。

items.title_en: Livenerf: Has Opus 5.5 been nerfed yet?
items.title_zh: Livenerf：Opus 5.5 是否已经被削弱？
items.summary_en: A quick take on whether Opus 5.5 has been nerfed, including patch notes and community sentiment.
items.summary_zh: 对 Opus 5.5 是否被削弱进行快速解读，结合补丁记录与社区情绪。

items.title_en: Surprisingly complex waves reveal the brain's inner workings
items.title_zh: 令人惊讶地复杂的脑波揭示大脑内部运作
items.summary_en: New measurements reveal brain activity exhibits surprisingly complex, multi-scale waves, challenging simple models of neural function. The finding reshapes how we model cognition, interpret neuroimaging, and design AI inspired by brain dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 新测量揭示大脑活动呈现出出乎意料的复杂、多尺度波动，挑战了简单的神经功能模型。这一发现将影响对认知建模、神经影像解读，以及受脑动力学启发的 AI 设计。

items.title_en: A brief history of the Bloomberg terminal
items.title_zh: 彭博终端的简史
items.summary_en: The Bloomberg Terminal revolutionized finance by bundling real-time market data, trading tools, and messaging into a single terminal. The piece traces its origins in the 1980s, its enduring business model, and how it shaped data licensing and professional workflows.
items.summary_zh: 彭博终端自1980年代起就把实时市场数据、交易工具和通讯功能打包到一个设备中，彻底改变金融行业的工作流程与信息获取方式。文章回顾其发展历程、持久的商业模式，以及对数据授权和专业工作流的深远影响。

items.title_en: 5x faster Edge Functions: V8 isolates to Firecracker MicroVMs
items.title_zh: 5倍加速的边缘函数：从 V8 isolates 到 Firecracker 微VM
items.summary_en: Netlify’s edge runtime shift uses Firecracker microVMs to isolate functions, delivering roughly 5x faster cold-starts and improved security compared with V8 isolates. The move signals a broader trend toward stronger isolation at the edge without sacrificing latency.
items.summary_zh: Netlify 将边缘函数从 V8 isolates 迁移到 Firecracker 微VM，带来约 5 倍的冷启动加速与更好的隔离性。此举反映了在边缘计算中以更强隔离换取低延迟的一股趋势。

items.title_en: Singapore govt dating app uses Gale-Shapley stable marriage algorithm
items.title_zh: 新加坡政府的约会应用采用稳定婚配算法（Gale-Shapley）
items.summary_en: Singapore's government dating app uses the Gale-Shapley stable marriage algorithm to optimize matches. The approach raises questions about privacy, consent, and fairness in algorithmic matchmaking while illustrating how formal matching theory can inform consumer apps.
items.summary_zh: 新加坡政府的交友应用采用稳定婚配算法（Gale-Shapley）来优化配对。该做法引发关于隐私、同意和算法公平性的讨论，同时展示了正式匹配理论在消费级应用中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: Halfspace experimental IDE for solid modeling with distance fields
items.title_zh: Halfspace：用于距离场的实验性实体建模集成开发环境
items.summary_en: Halfspace offers an experimental IDE for solid modeling built around distance fields, enabling intuitive sculpting and real-time feedback on geometry. The project hints at a future where distance-field representations power more accessible CAD workflows and robust blending operations.
items.summary_zh: Halfspace 提供一个以距离场为核心的实验性实体建模集成开发环境，支持直观的造型和几何的实时反馈。该项目显示距离场表示在 CAD 工作流中提升建模体验和布尔运算鲁棒性的潜力。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Magnitude (YC S25) – Self-optimizing inference engine for agents
items.title_zh: Launch HN: Magnitude (YC S25) – 面向代理的自我优化推理引擎
items.summary_en: Magnitude is a self-optimizing inference engine designed for agents, automatically tuning runtimes and workloads to boost performance and efficiency. It sits at the intersection of AI agent frameworks and efficient inference, promising to reduce manual tuning and hardware waste. Backed by YC S25, it signals growing interest in tooling for autonomous agents.
items.summary_zh: Magnitude 是一个面向代理的自我优化推理引擎，能够自动调参以提升推理性能和能效，减少人工调优工作。它处在 AI 代理框架与高效推理技术的交汇处，代表了为自走代理提升算力利用率的一条新路径。由 YC S25 支持，反映了对自动化代理工具的热切关注。

items.title_en: The last time my family was replaced by technology
items.title_zh: 科技替代家人：我的家人经历的那一次
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on how technology reshaped family life, perhaps displacing in-person interactions with screens. It explores balancing tech use with meaningful togetherness and the bittersweet costs of always-on connectivity.
items.summary_zh: 对科技如何改变家庭生活的个人反思，描述屏幕替代了面对面互动的场景。探讨在始终在线的便利与陪伴质量之间寻找平衡，以及数字化带来的成本。

items.title_en: Before pixels: Modular industrial dashboards
items.title_zh: 像素前的模块化工业仪表板
items.summary_en: Before pixels argues for modular, data-driven dashboards in industrial settings, arguing that composable UI components beat pixel-perfect, one-off dashboards.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在工业场景中采用模块化、数据驱动的仪表板，以替代追求像素级完美的单一界面。通过讨论如何将传感器数据、设备遥测和分析组件解耦组合，提升操作员的可视性和系统鲁棒性。

items.title_en: What TLA+ can and can't check
items.title_zh: TLA+ 能检查什么、不能检查什么
items.summary_en: TLA+ excels at modeling concurrent systems and proving invariants, but it can't verify all real-world properties that depend on timing, performance, or external systems. The piece underscores the discipline's limits and best practices for formal verification.
items.summary_zh: TLA+ 在建模并发系统、证明不变性方面很强，但对依赖时间、性能或外部系统的现实属性并非全能。文章强调了形式化验证的边界与最佳实践。

items.title_en: AI borrowers face tough sell in risky corners of US credit market
items.title_zh: AI 借款人在美国高风险信贷市场难以获得融资
items.summary_en: Lenders are cautious about AI-powered borrowers in riskier corners of the US credit market, tightening underwriting and reducing appetite for such borrowers.
items.summary_zh: 放贷机构对在高风险信贷领域使用 AI 的借款人持观望态度，信贷审核趋于严格，愿意提供的额度也在下降。文章强调了模型风险、审核透明度和市场环境如何共同影响 AI 驱动借款人在信贷市场中的获取融资能力。

items.title_en: Commit description as a thinking tool
items.title_zh: 将提交描述作为思考工具
items.summary_en: Using commit descriptions as a thinking tool reframes code reasoning as a sequence of explainable steps. The approach helps developers externalize decisions, surface assumptions, and guide debugging and refactoring.
items.summary_zh: 把提交描述当作思考工具，将代码推理外化为可解释的步骤序列。这样做可以帮助开发者把决策、假设暴露出来，指引调试和重构的方向。

items.title_en: SDF vs. MSDF vs. Slug: GPU Text Rendering
items.title_zh: GPU 字体渲染：SDF、MSDF、Slug 对比
items.summary_en: The post compares SDF, MSDF, Slug, and Rive approaches for GPU-based text rendering, highlighting how multi-channel signed distance fields reduce blurriness and improve edge sharpness across fonts. It discusses tradeoffs in atlas size, preprocessing, and runtime performance.
items.summary_zh: 文章对比了 SDF、MSDF、Slug 与 Rive 在 GPU 字体渲染中的差异，指出多通道 Signed Distance Fields 如何提升字体边缘锐度与一致性。并讨论了图集大小、预处理和运行时性能等权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Yantra – an LALR(1) parser generator for C++
items.title_zh: Show HN：Yantra — 面向 C++ 的 LALR(1) 解析器生成器
items.summary_en: Yantra is a new LALR(1) parser generator for C++. It aims to streamline building language parsers by emitting clean, idiomatic C++ code and parsing tables. For projects where tight integration with modern C++ tooling matters, it offers an alternative to traditional parser generators with a focus on ergonomics and performance.
items.summary_zh: Yantra 是一个面向 C++ 的 LALR(1) 解析器生成器，旨在通过输出整洁、符合现代 C++ 风格的代码与解析表来简化解析器开发。在需要与现代 C++ 工具链紧密集成的场景中，它提供了一个对传统生成器的高效、易用的替代方案。

items.title_en: CHOMPI portable sampler instrument is now open-source (hardware and software)
items.title_zh: CHOMPI 便携取样仪现已开源（硬件与软件）
items.summary_en: CHOMPI's portable sampler is released as open-source hardware and software, inviting community contributions and enabling researchers and makers to build and customize a compact field instrument. Open-source hardware accelerates iteration and reproducibility.
items.summary_zh: CHOMPI 便携取样仪现已开源，软硬件均开放，鼓励社区贡献与定制。开源硬件有助于缩短迭代周期、提高可重复性并推动音频研究和创客应用。

items.title_en: SDF Public Access Unix System ... est. 1987
items.title_zh: SDF 公共访问 UNIX 系统，成立于 1987 年
items.summary_en: SDF Public Access UNIX System is one of the oldest community-run free Unix systems, established in 1987. It remains a living archive of classic tooling and a reminder of grassroots computing culture.
items.summary_zh: SDF 公共访问 UNIX 系统是最早的社区运营免费 UNIX 系统之一，创建于 1987 年，至今仍在运行，成为经典工具集的活档案与草根计算文化的象征。

items.title_en: LinkedIn Larpmaxxing
items.title_zh: LinkedIn 的 Larpmaxxing：职业社交平台上的角色扮演
items.summary_en: A sharp takedown of performative persona-building on LinkedIn, analyzing how people curate professional identities and the social incentives that drive it. It argues for more authentic networking and critical consumption of online profiles.
items.summary_zh: 尖锐批评 LinkedIn 上的表演性自我塑造现象，分析人们如何精心策划职业形象以及背后的社会激励。主张更真实的社交与对线上个人资料的批判性消费。

items.title_en: Great Dirhombicosidodecahedron ("Miller's Monster")
items.title_zh: 伟大的 Dirhombicosidodecahedron（“米勒的怪兽”）
items.summary_en: The page surveys the Great Dirhombicosidodecahedron, a striking nonconvex uniform polyhedron nicknamed Miller's Monster. It showcases its geometry, symmetry and coordinates, illustrating how such shapes push the boundaries of conventional polyhedral classification.
items.summary_zh: 页面介绍伟大的 Dirhombicosidodecahedron，这一非凸均匀多面体，绰号“米勒的怪兽”。内容展示其几何结构、对称性与坐标，体现此类形体对传统多面体分类的挑战。

items.title_en: Functional Ultrasound Imaging (fUSI) from scratch
items.title_zh: 从零开始的功能性超声成像（fUSI）
items.summary_en: An explainer building functional ultrasound imaging from first principles, showing how ultrasound can monitor brain activity with high temporal resolution. It highlights potential for portable neuroimaging and complements existing MRI/EEG approaches.
items.summary_zh: 从基础原理出发，文章系统讲解功能性超声成像（fUSI）的实现与原理，以及如何以高时间分辨率监测大脑活动。其潜力在于实现便携式神经影像，与 MRI/EEG 等方法互补。

items.title_en: Moist-Electric Wallpaper for Indoor Energy Harvesting and Humidity Management
items.title_zh: 用于室内能量收集与湿度管理的湿电壁纸
items.summary_en: Researchers propose a wallpaper that harvests energy from ambient humidity to power low-power electronics, coupling humidity-driven electrochemical processes with flexible substrates. It hints at near-permanent IoT devices with minimal maintenance, while noting efficiency and durability challenges.
items.summary_zh: 研究团队提出一种可从环境湿度中收集能量的湿电壁纸，利用湿度驱动的电化学过程在柔性基材上发电。该技术有望为低功耗物联网设备提供长期供电，但也面临效率与耐久性挑战。

items.title_en: pldb: programming languages papers
items.title_zh: pldb：编程语言论文数据库
items.summary_en: PLDB compiles programming languages papers into a navigable database, enabling researchers to search by topic, venue, or year. It serves as a practical screening tool for staying current on PL theory and practice and for literature surveys.
items.summary_zh: PLDB 将编程语言领域的论文整合成可检索的数据库，方便按主题、刊物或年份检索，帮助研究者跟踪理论与实践方向的最新进展，并支持文献调研。

items.title_en: Coltrane's Tone Circle
items.title_zh: 科特兰的音圈
items.summary_en: Delves into Coltrane's Tone Circle, a conceptual tool for mapping tonal relationships in jazz improvisation. It explains how Coltrane navigates chord changes and scale choices, offering practical insight for musicians and algorithmic composers.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨科特兰的音圈，这一用于在爵士即兴中映射音高关系的概念工具。它揭示科特兰如何在和声变更与音阶选择中穿梭，为音乐人和算法作曲者提供实用洞见。

items.title_en: Doing a Machine Learning PhD While Working in Japan
items.title_zh: 在日本工作同时攻读机器学习博士
items.summary_en: The piece chronicles navigating a machine-learning PhD while employed in Japan, touching on visa hurdles, work culture, and balancing research with full-time work. It offers pragmatic tips for remote collaboration, funding, and leveraging Japan’s research ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 本文记录在日本工作同时攻读机器学习博士学位的经历，涉及签证、工作文化与研究与工作的平衡等挑战。给出在远程协作、资金获取以及利用日本研究生态方面的实用建议。

items.title_en: Show HN: Lathoa, a math app for kids where the AI is wrong on purpose
items.title_zh: Show HN：Lathoa——一个故意让 AI 犯错的儿童数学应用
items.summary_en: Lathoa is a math app for kids that deliberately presents incorrect AI responses to teach users about error detection and debugging. The project frames mistakes as educational prompts, encouraging critical thinking and resilience in young learners.
items.summary_zh: Lathoa 是一个面向儿童的数学应用，故意给出错误的 AI 回答以训练用户发现并修正错误的能力。通过把错误当作学习线索，鼓励年轻用户进行批判性思维和韧性训练。

items.title_en: NRC issues first U.S. construction permit for a BWRX-300 small modular reactor
items.title_zh: NRC 颁发美国首张 BWRX-300 小型模块化反应堆建设许可
items.summary_en: The NRC issued the first U.S. construction permit for a BWRX-300 small modular reactor, marking a milestone for SMR deployment. The project at TVA's Clinch River site exemplifies renewed interest in modular nuclear energy and tests licensing pathways.
items.summary_zh: 美国核规制委员会颁发了首张 BWRX-300 小型模块化反应堆建设许可，标志着美国微型反应堆部署迈出关键一步。田纳西河 TVA 的 Clinch River 项目体现了对模块化核能的重新关注，并测试了许可流程。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ledge.sh – Runnable Markdown Notes
items.title_zh: Show HN：Ledge.sh——可运行的 Markdown 笔记
items.summary_en: Show HN: Ledge.sh lets you write Markdown notes with runnable code blocks, enabling reproducible demos directly in docs. Great for sharing experiments, tutorials, and live data in a lightweight format.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：Ledge.sh 让你在 Markdown 笔记中编写可运行的代码块，直接在文档中实现可复现的演示。非常适合分享实验、教程和实时数据，且格式轻量。

items.title_en: Automating Wi-Fi setup testing on the ESP32
items.title_zh: 在 ESP32 上自动化 Wi‑Fi 设置测试
items.summary_en: This post describes automating Wi‑Fi setup testing for the ESP32, reducing manual QA effort for IoT devices. It likely covers test harnesses, scripting, and reproducible scenarios to validate seamless network connections across environments.
items.summary_zh: 该文章介绍在 ESP32 上自动化 Wi‑Fi 设置测试，降低物联网设备的人工质控成本。内容涉及测试框架、脚本以及在不同网络环境中复现的场景，以验证稳定的连网体验。

items.title_en: Solving Factorio Quality
items.title_zh: 提升 Factorio 产线质量
items.summary_en: Presents a practical framework to measure and improve factory quality in Factorio, with concrete patterns to identify bottlenecks and waste. It emphasizes modular design, throughput benchmarks, and robust error handling in factory layouts.
items.summary_zh: 本文提出在 Factorio 中评估并提升产线质量的实用框架，给出可操作的设计模式与可量化指标，帮助玩家定位瓶颈与浪费。通过模块化设计和吞吐基准，提升大规模工厂的鲁棒性和效率。

items.title_en: Why the Bronze Age Collapsed
items.title_zh: 青铜时代为何崩溃
items.summary_en: Scholars synthesize climate, trade, and social factors to argue the Bronze Age collapse was multi-causal rather than caused by a single trigger.
items.summary_zh: 学者综合气候、贸易与社会因素，认为青铜时代崩溃是多因素综合作用的结果，而非单一原因。此文强调古代社会的连锁失败如何为现代韧性规划提供启示。

items.title_en: Jevotron: Multiple Jev integrations from the command line
items.title_zh: Jevotron：从命令行实现多个 Jev 集成
items.summary_en: Jevotron exposes a command-line interface to wire together multiple Jev integrations, enabling automation and scripting of workflows. It helps developers orchestrate disparate tools without leaving the terminal, boosting productivity for complex projects.
items.summary_zh: Jevotron 提供命令行界面，使用户能够将多个 Jev 集成在一起，实现工作流的自动化和脚本化。该工具让开发者在终端内就能编排不同工具，提高处理复杂项目的效率。

items.title_en: Phyllotaxis: An audio-reactive LED display
items.title_zh: 花序学：音频响应的LED显示屏
items.summary_en: A project that turns audio input into evolving LED patterns using a phyllotaxis-inspired layout. It demonstrates real-time generative visuals and a tactile approach to audio-reactive art, bridging nature-inspired math with hardware creativity.
items.summary_zh: 一个把音频输入实时转化为 LED 动态图案的作品，采用花序结构的布局。展示了将自然启发的几何与音频驱动的可视化相结合的即时生成艺术。

items.title_en: Responsible Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
items.title_zh: AI 生成的数学成果的负责任发布
items.summary_en: Proposes responsible release practices for AI-generated mathematics, including verification, provenance, and human oversight. Argues that AI-produced mathematical results should be treated with caution and validated by experts before publication.
items.summary_zh: 提出在 AI 生成的数学成果发布中应遵循的负责任实践，包括验证、可溯性和人类监督。强调应谨慎对待 AI 产出的数学结论，并让专家在公开发表前进行验证。

items.title_en: I could've accessed 17T Microsoft records
items.title_zh: 我本来可以访问17万亿条微软记录
items.summary_en: A disclosure-style post argues that misconfigured access points could expose an enormous trove of Microsoft records, underscoring the fragility of giant data stores. It calls for stronger access controls, auditing, and responsible disclosure practices.
items.summary_zh: 作者声称通过某些错误配置可以访问17万亿条微软记录，凸显巨型数据仓库的脆弱性。文章强调需要更强的访问控制、更完善的审计与负责任的披露流程。

items.title_en: Show HN: JBR-001 – An open-source 3D printable desktop robot
items.title_zh: Show HN：JBR-001——一个开源3D可打印桌面机器人
items.summary_en: JBR-001 is an open-source, 3D-printable desktop robot designed for hands-on learning and rapid experimentation. Built around an Arduino Uno, the project emphasizes accessibility and low-cost robotics. It serves as a practical blueprint for hobbyists to prototype small autonomous or interactive assistants.
items.summary_zh: JBR-001 是一个开源、可3D打印的桌面机器人，面向动手学习和快速试验。以 Arduino Uno 为核心，强调可及性与低成本机器人应用，为爱好者提供了原型化小型自主或交互助手的实用蓝本。

items.title_en: Show HN: A working 3D model of an Enigma machine
items.title_zh: Show HN：可工作的恩尼格玛机3D模型
items.summary_en: A functional 3D model of an Enigma machine demonstrates rotor wiring and gears that reproduce historic encryption mechanics. It serves as a tangible bridge to crypto history and a helpful teaching tool.
items.summary_zh: 展示一个可工作的恩尼格玛机3D模型，展示转子与齿轮如何再现历史加密机制，成为 crypto 历史的直观教学工具。

items.title_en: Mathematical Origami
items.title_zh: 数学折纸
items.summary_en: Mathematical Origami demonstrates how origami concepts illuminate geometry, topology, and algorithms. The resource showcases fold patterns and interactive models that make abstract math tangible. It's a bridge between art and rigorous math for learners and enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: 数学折纸展示了折纸概念如何揭示几何、拓扑与算法。该资源展示了折痕模式与交互模型，使抽象数学变得直观易懂。它将艺术与严谨数学联系起来，适合学习者与爱好者。

items.title_en: Burning Man death rates – A short lesson in statistics
items.title_zh: Burning Man 死亡率：一个统计学教训
items.summary_en: The piece uses Burning Man death rates to illustrate basic statistics pitfalls like small-sample variability and selection bias. It emphasizes how sensational statistics can mislead without proper context, and demonstrates how to think about rates per population at events.
items.summary_zh: 本文用 Burning Man 的死亡率来揭示小样本变异性与选择偏差等统计陷阱。若缺乏恰当背景，统计数字容易被误解；文中展示了如何用事件规模来合理解读死亡率等比率。

items.title_en: Show HN: Dental Scope – Interactive 3D dental anatomy
items.title_zh: Show HN：Dental Scope——Interactive 3D 牙科解剖
items.summary_en: Dental Scope offers an interactive 3D view of dental anatomy for education and training, enabling zooming, labeling, and exploration of teeth and surrounding structures. It exemplifies how web tech can aid medical education and patient understanding.
items.summary_zh: Dental Scope 提供牙科解剖的互动三维视图，便于教育与培训，支持放大、标注和结构探索，展示了网页技术在医学教育与患者理解中的应用潜力。

items.title_en: Dumb servers, smart clients: Distributing OS images with Quarry
items.title_zh: 愚蠢的服务器，聪明的客户端：用 Quarry 分发操作系统镜像
items.summary_en: Quarry shifts OS-image distribution from server-centric to client-assisted, enabling scalable network boot and reducing server load. The approach can improve resilience and throughput in large fleets.
items.summary_zh: Quarry 将 OS 镜像分发的工作从服务器端转向客户端协作，支持可扩展的网络启动并降低服务器压力。此方法在大规模部署中提升了鲁棒性与吞吐量。

items.title_en: Reverse-engineering a $35 backup camera display (AMT630A)
items.title_zh: 一个价值 35 美元的倒车摄像头显示屏的逆向工程（AMT630A）
items.summary_en: A hardware reverse-engineering deep-dive uncovers the internal controller AMT630A used in cheap backup camera displays, revealing how to repurpose or replace it. It offers practical insights into sourcing affordable components and understanding display interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 对一款价值约 35 美元的倒车摄像头显示屏进行逆向工程，揭示了其内部控制芯片 AMT630A 的工作原理与接口。提供了利用廉价部件进行再利用的实用洞见。

items.title_en: Getting out of the way: my robotics crash course
items.title_zh: 让路而非抢戏：我的机器人学速成课
items.summary_en: A hands-on robotics crash course that argues for simplicity and letting systems do the work rather than over-optimizing; covers practical tips on sensors, control loops, and incremental experimentation.
items.summary_zh: 一本强调“让系统自己完成工作”的机器人入门速成课程，主张以简馀为上，讲解传感器、控制循环和渐进式实验的实用要点。

items.title_en: Hacking SimCity 2000 saved games
items.title_zh: 对 SimCity 2000 存档的破解研究
items.summary_en: A dive into hacking SimCity 2000 saved games, revealing how the game stores progress and unlocks, offering insight into retro game save formats.
items.summary_zh: 对 SimCity 2000 的存档进行破解，揭示游戏如何存储进度与解锁内容的机制，为复古游戏的存档格式提供见解。文章还探讨了上世纪90年代末存档系统的设计局限以及玩家对其进行修改的尝试。

items.title_en: PlayBook: A Programmable Paper Notebook [video]
items.title_zh: PlayBook：一款可编程的纸质笔记本 [视频]
items.summary_en: A video demo of PlayBook, a programmable paper notebook that blends physical pages with programmable functionality. The project hints at a tangible interface where notes or drawings can trigger programmable behaviors, showcasing a hybrid between paper and electronics.
items.summary_zh: PlayBook 展示了一款可编程的纸质笔记本，将纸页与可编程功能结合。该项目暗示了一种让笔记或绘画触发可编程行为的实体界面，展示了纸本与电子元件的混合潜力。

items.title_en: Book of Shapes – Collection of minimal, generative and customizable SVG-patterns
items.title_zh: 形状之书：极简、生成式且可定制的 SVG 图案集
items.summary_en: An online collection of minimal, generative SVG patterns that you can tailor to your needs. It offers a library of scalable vector motifs ideal for design systems, generative art, or background textures. The emphasis is on lightweight, customizable patterns that can spark quick visual ideas.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个极简、生成式的 SVG 图案合集，用户可以按需定制。它为设计系统、生成艺术或背景纹理提供可扩展的矢量 motif，强调轻量且易定制的图案，能够快速点燃视觉灵感。
